name: Undertaker Mordo
summary: At Deathknell's crypt, Undertaker Mordo greets Forsaken as they wake to a world changed. He tells them they are free of the Lich King's control and sends those with their wits toward Queen Sylvanas's cause. The bodies that never stir are cast into the fire.

sections.title: The Awakening at Deathknell
sections.body: In Tirisfal Glades, corpses break free of the Scourge at Deathknell's crypt. Newly awakened Forsaken find a world they no longer recognize. Undertaker Mordo tests their sanity and tells them what they have become. Then he directs them to serve Queen Sylvanas Windrunner.

sections.title: Those Who Do Not Wake
sections.body:
Some bodies brought to the crypt never wake. Mordo soon casts them into the fire. Those who stir meet his dry impatience and little ceremony.

If the newly risen have kept their wits, Mordo sends them up the steps and down the road to the chapel. There, Shadow Priest Sarvis explains their new existence. The mindless zombies overrunning the village's north are Sarvis's concern, so he sends the newly risen to destroy them.

faq.answer: Undertaker Mordo tends the crypt at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He greets newly risen Forsaken and directs them into service.

faq.q: Why is he standing in a graveyard?
aliases: why is mordo at the graves
faq.answer: Undertaker Mordo keeps watch at Deathknell's crypt, where undead freed from the Lich King's control wake. He greets them as they stir.

faq.q: What happens to the undead who lose their minds upon waking?
faq.answer: Bodies that never wake are cast into the fire. Shadow Priest Sarvis sends the newly risen to destroy the mindless zombies overrunning Deathknell's north, even when those zombies were once their brothers and sisters.

faq.q: Where does Mordo send newly risen Forsaken?
aliases: where do i go after mordo
faq.answer: Mordo sends newly awakened Forsaken with their wits intact out of the crypt and down the road to the chapel. There, Shadow Priest Sarvis explains what it means to join the Forsaken.

angles.text: As an Undead, you first meet Undertaker Mordo when you open your eyes in death. He guides your first steps in service to Queen Sylvanas.
